verdict.rationale: Statsig documents its own product analytics tool, Metrics Explorer, for analyzing how users interact with the product. It also offers multiple switchable chart types over selected events, which plausibly covers self-serve journey analysis, but funnels themselves are never named in the evidence. Missing for 10: explicit funnel charts, step-by-step drop-off and conversion analysis, evidence of no-analyst self-serve usability for founders, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
